gloss: cash advance; provisional payment; temporary disbursement

definitions.gloss: cash advance; provisional payment; temporary disbursement
definitions.explanation: Money paid out before the final amount is known, to be settled up later. Typically an advance given to an employee for travel or entertainment costs, reconciled against receipts on return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}→出張費：25964_shucchouhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仮払|かりばら}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a cash advance for my business trip expenses.

examples.japanese: {仮払|かりばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the cash advance request form to accounting.

examples.japanese: {帰社後|きしゃご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えて→添える：13315_soeru⟧{仮払|かりばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After returning to the office, I settled the cash advance with the receipts attached.

notes:
⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧ (temporary, provisional) + ⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ (payment). The money is handed over first and the exact amount worked out afterward, so a {仮払|かりばら}い is always followed by a ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ (settlement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮払|かりばら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a cash advance
- {仮払|かりばら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for a cash advance
- {仮払|かりばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧: settlement of a cash advance
- ⟦{仮払金|かりばらいきん}→仮払金：30243_karibaraikin⟧: the advanced money (as a balance-sheet item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: advance payment — the amount is already fixed; no later settlement is needed
- ⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{替|か}え: paying on someone's behalf — you use your own money first and are reimbursed
